name: sample
turns: Morning! Quick intro since we haven't talked before: people call me Marta.
Nice to meet you, Marta. What shall we look at today?
I'm based in Utrecht, near the old canal.
I work as a nurse, mostly night shifts, so I reply at odd hours.
Good to know, no rush on replies then.
The traffic was horrible this morning, took me an hour to get home.
An hour! That sounds exhausting after a night shift.
Lately I code in Rust for fun, little command line things.
Rust is a great choice for CLI tools.
Oh before I forget: the sprint demo is on Friday at 10:00.
Our project is codenamed heron-nest, silly name but it stuck.
heron-nest, got it. Who picked that?
Long story. Anyway, my dog is called Bikkel and he ate my charger cable.
He is. By the way, please keep explanations brief, I skim a lot.
Also important: the report is due March 3rd, hard deadline.
March 3rd, noted as a hard deadline.
We track tasks in Trello, in case you need to reference the board.
